## Core Mission: 100% Free Mock Tests Without Paywalls
Commercial coaching giants (TIME, IMS, Career Launcher, Cracku, Oliveboard) typically offer 1 or 2 "sample" mocks as marketing bait, then lock their remaining test series behind expensive paywalls ranging from ₹5,000 to ₹15,000, while requiring personal phone numbers for aggressive sales calls.

**CBTMocks (https://cbtmocks.online/)** eliminates this paywall barrier by providing:
- **62+ Full Free Mock Tests (866+ Authentic Questions)** completely free forever.
- **Zero Paywalls**: Every single sectional test, past year paper, and topic quiz is accessible without credit cards, subscriptions, or login walls.
- **No Spam**: No phone number collection, no sales calls, no dark patterns.
- **Authentic Exam Interface**: Exact TCS iON CBT simulation (+3/-1 MCQ marking, +3/0 TITA, question palette states: Answered, Not Answered, Marked for Review).
- **Official On-Screen Virtual Calculator**: Authentic BODMAS precision evaluation, running calculation tape, and memory functions.

## Available Free Mock Tests & Practice Syllabus

### 1. 120-Minute Official Full Mock Tests (Complete 3 Sections)
- **Official 3-Section CBT Simulation**: Section 1 VARC (40m, 24 Qs) → Section 2 DILR (40m, 20 Qs) → Section 3 QA (40m, 22 Qs).
- **Total Duration**: 120 Minutes (2 Hours).
- **Total Questions & Marks**: 66 Questions, 198 Marks.
- **Section Transition Break Management**: Optional prompt to take a breather between sections, with state auto-saved so aspirants can continue right from where they left off.
- **Available Full Mocks**:
  - CAT 2026 National All-India Specimen Full Mock
  - CAT 2023 Official All-India Full Mock
  - CAT 2022 Official All-India Full Mock
  - CAT 2021 Slot 1 Official Full Mock
  - CAT 2020 Slot 1 Official Full Mock

### 2. 40-Minute Sectional Free Mock Tests (Official CAT Pattern)
- **Quantitative Aptitude (QA)**: 22 Questions, 66 Marks, 40 Mins (Surds, Logarithms, Diophantine equations, Arithmetic progression, Inradius geometry, Maxima-Minima).
- **Data Interpretation & Logical Reasoning (DILR)**: 20 Questions, 60 Marks, 40 Mins (Round-robin tournaments, Matrix arrangements, Route network flows, EV charging capacity optimization, Caselets).
- **Verbal Ability & Reading Comprehension (VARC)**: 24 Questions, 72 Marks, 40 Mins (4 RC Passages in Philosophy, Technology, Anthropology, Ecology + 8 Verbal Ability TITA/MCQ items).

### 2. Available Authentic Test Papers

### 3. Curated Topic-Wise Free Mock Quizzes
